name: class-sz
description: Specialized Claude assistance for classy_szlite — a pure-JAX cosmology code that covers CMB Cls, matter Pk (linear and nonlinear), distances, derived parameters, and the halo-model tSZ Cl^yy bandpower likelihood. Backed by the v2 CosmoPower emulators used in the ACT DR6 extended-cosmology analyses. Pipelines, gradient probes, NUTS/HMC sampling, and cobaya bandpower likelihood scaffolding.
